editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood staple for over a decade, #1 Chop Suey delivers generous portions of classic Chinese comfort food at prices that keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order for delivery—it arrives hot and fast—and ask for extra egg in your fried rice like the regulars do; Beatrice at the counter is known for exceptional service.
signatureDishes: Beef fried rice with extra egg
